reviewer: browser_login agent; independent review of automatic_release-authored one-line fallback and Git regression

closed_findings.title: The next automatic release stopped after the first release emptied Unreleased
closed_findings.original_behavior: The first generated release moves authored Unreleased content into its version section and preserves an empty Unreleased heading. A later valid mainline change without handwritten notes then caused bump_files to raise instead of generating the next version patch.
closed_findings.resolution: Empty or whitespace-only Unreleased content now uses the existing language-specific fixed description referencing the exact base SHA. Nonempty authored notes continue to move unchanged under the new version. The generated marker, strict version consistency, deterministic patch reconstruction and unrelated-file rejection remain intact.
closed_findings.verification: A real temporary Git repository completes three release cycles: 1.3.0 preserves authored bilingual notes; 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 each follow a separately committed ordinary improvement without adding notes and use their own base SHA in bilingual fallback text. Every cycle commits exactly the six release files and passes verify_generated. Restoring the old empty-notes rejection only in memory makes this new regression fail on the next empty-Unreleased release.

verification.result: Three cycles with distinct committed baselines; repeated bump_files calls agree byte-for-byte; generated diffs contain exactly RELEASE_FILES; all commits pass verify_generated; authored history persists; later fallback sections contain the current base SHA and do not repeat authored notes.

Replaced only the one-line fallback in an in-memory module copy with the original empty-notes ValueError. The same new real-Git regression failed with that original error. No production file was mutated.
Production diff is one fallback expression in bump_files. Previous generated-patch/manual-addition rejection and root/nonempty endpoint argv tests still pass. git diff --check passed.

limits: No remote repository write, workflow dispatch, version PR, merge, tag or release publication was performed in this review.
The continuation evidence uses a real temporary Git repository and local release functions. Full hosted CI and actual multi-release workflow execution remain separate gates.
Earlier frozen review reports and the metadata-path follow-up report were preserved as historical evidence; this report records the new source hashes.
